profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Oran Inc
profile.summary: Experienced Development Team Lead with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Java, leading and mentoring team members, Communication, Enterprise Architecture and Design, Hibernate, large scale databases and Enterprise Web Development. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science (MS) focused in System Design & Programming.  Many years of experience leading agile scrum development projects.
